summary: The filing reports the departure of Patrick Kirscht, Chief Credit Officer of Oportun Financial Corp, effective June 15, 2026. The departure was mutual and without disagreement. The Transition Agreement provides cash severance of $525,300 (12 months base salary), a prorated bonus of $155,287, a retention cash award of $535,500, COBRA premium coverage for up to 12 months, accelerated vesting of 95,603 RSUs, and additional vesting of 17,907 time-based RSUs and 75.6% of PSUs subject to TSR goal. No deal terms are involved. Watch for potential interim appointments or future leadership changes.
